# AceMQ for Rails — API reference

Every public class and method in `lib/`, generated by YARD from the same commit
as the rest of the site.

Start at `AceMQ::Rails` for the connection, publishing and the health report;
`AceMQ::Rails::Consumer` for writing a handler; `AceMQ::Rails::Configuration` for
every setting and what it means; `AceMQ::Rails::Runner` for what the consumer
process does and what a drain finishes; and `AceMQ::Rails::Railtie` for how it is
all wired in.

The library underneath has a reference of its own at
[acemq.org/acemq-ruby-amqp/api](https://acemq.org/acemq-ruby-amqp/api/index.html).

The prose documentation — what each of these is for, and why it works the way it
does — is at
[acemq.org/acemq-ruby-amqp-rails](https://acemq.org/acemq-ruby-amqp-rails/).

---

This page exists so that YARD does not render the README here instead. A README
is written for somebody looking at a repository, and it opens with badge images
fetched from a third party on every view — which is not what somebody who opened
an API reference came to find out.
